name: Simulator: 'Verify in Stripe' replays an edited timeline in a Stripe test clock and matches
description: FR4 for your own timeline: the edited timeline (not a golden id) is replayed live in Stripe test mode and must match Tera to the cent.

planSteps.description: Open the app home page and choose 'S01' in the 'Load scenario' dropdown
In the first event, change the 'quantity' field from its current value to 2
Assert the '✅ Matches golden expected' badge is no longer shown, because the timeline was edited
Click the 'Verify in Stripe' button and wait up to 120 seconds until a result box appears below the buttons (the button text changes back from 'Replaying in Stripe…')
Assert the result box shows '✅ Matches Stripe' and mentions a test clock id starting with 'clock_'
